exclusions: One malformed concatenated query with no results and one transitional author-only result view were excluded from all totals.

First/last-page samples are not complete middle-page coverage. Shred/model and Blender-Sith were read completely.
No attachment, linked media or game-runtime inspection; no complete-server claim.
